settings.admin_auth_hint: Admin password is set. Please enter it to access key management.
settings.admin_wrong: Wrong admin password, please try again.
settings.billing_hint: Three modes are mutually exclusive. Only one can be active. Changes take effect immediately.
settings.billing_none_desc: All valid keys have unlimited calls
settings.key_token_quota_hint: Charged by input text Token count; -1 = unlimited
settings.key_quota_invalid: Call quota must be -1 (unlimited) or a positive integer
settings.key_token_invalid: Token quota must be -1 (unlimited) or a positive integer
settings.keys_none: No API keys yet. Add a key to enable authentication for OpenAI endpoints (/v1/*).
settings.confirm_reset: Reset this key's used count to 0?
settings.confirm_reset_tokens: Reset this key's Token usage to 0?
settings.prompt_new_quota: Enter new call quota (-1=unlimited, positive=call count)
settings.prompt_new_token_quota: Enter new Token quota (-1=unlimited, positive=Token count)
settings.prompt_invalid_number: Please enter a valid number (-1 or positive integer)
settings.info_billing_mode: Billing Mode: Three mutually exclusive options. "Per-Call" shows only call quota fields; "Per-Token" shows only Token quota fields; "Billing Off" hides all quota fields and all keys have unlimited calls.
settings.info_quota: Call Quota: -1 means unlimited; a positive number is the max call count, decremented by 1 on each successful synthesis.
settings.info_token_quota: Token Quota: -1 means unlimited; a positive number is decremented by the input text's Token count. Quick presets: 1/100/1K/10K/100M Tokens.
settings.info_over_quota: Over Quota: Exhausted call quota returns 429; exhausted Token quota returns "Text-to-speech model quota exhausted. Please renew or purchase Pro, or contact your model provider."
settings.info_admin: Admin Access: When admin_password is not set, only localhost (127.0.0.1) can manage; when set, password is required.
settings.info_api: Internal endpoint (/api/tts) always requires no key; OpenAI endpoints (/v1/*) require key authentication.
settings.internal_hash_hint: The internal /api/tts endpoint requires a timestamped HMAC signature. Send this hash to requesters; they must pass X-Timestamp / X-Nonce / X-Hash headers. See README.
